# Synthetic China margin-financing C0 fixtures

These rows are synthetic and exist only for parser, T+1 PIT, missing-field,
revision, and source-health tests. They are not official exchange data and
cannot satisfy a real-data or production-admission gate.

The canonical series is `POS_CN_RZRQ`. The source identity and official
reference are kept in `config/china_leverage.yml`; no third-party mirror is
accepted by the parser.
